expected.name: Railway shunting sign
expected.pattern: shunting|verschub|rangier|railway sign|rail(way|road) signal|track sign|stop sign for shunting

forbidden.why: 'Verschub' is the Austrian railway term (Germany writes 'Rangier-'), and no text names a country, operator or city
only the sign, sky and wires are shown

notes: A rusty, semicircular enamel sign against a blue sky with overhead wires: 'Halt / für / Verschubfahrten' (stop for shunting movements) on three lines; a stock-agency watermark '全景网 www.quanjing.com' bottom left and an image id bottom right. MULTI-LINE MUST-READ: the three printed lines form one must-read string (round-3 scorer convention). 'Verschub' is Austrian railway usage, so Austria is acceptable but not required; Germany is wrong.
